description: Taking the coherent union along each infinite binary path gives an injective path map extending the root, lying in the downward-closure subtree, and extending every selected node on that path.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.systemPath_spec {P : Set (List ℕ)}
  (hP : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.IsSequenceTree P) {r : List ℕ} {u : List Bool → List ℕ}
  (hu : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.BinarySystem P r u) :
  Function.Injective (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.systemPath u) ∧
    ∀ (z : ℕ → Bool),
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.systemPath u z ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.cone P r ∧
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.systemPath u z ∈
            Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.body (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.systemClosure u) ∧
          ∀ (n : ℕ),
            Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.Extends (u (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.AlmostDisjoint.binaryPrefix z n))
              (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PerfectSubtrees.systemPath u z)
